Today I’m excited to finally share Ferndesk! The first help center that never goes out of date. At my last company, we shipped new product incredibly quickly. But as a small team, we never had the bandwidth to keep our docs up to date. We wanted to spend less time in support and more time growing the business, but our docs were a bottleneck. So one year ago, I set out to build a docs platform that keeps up with you. Today, Ferndesk saves 100+ SaaS teams 20-50 hours/mo on docs, and counting. In year two, we're going to help 1,000.

#### What's great [...] Juan Manuel Zolezzi

#### What's great

Evergreen documentation using our ticket history to find updates in our docs automatically.

#### What needs improvement

I believe it's the first time I got nothing to improve. At first admin dark mode was missing, but it was implemented some weeks after we started using it.

#### vs Alternatives

Zendesk

Mainly the ability to be able to host our documentation at a subfolder of our main domain, instead of using a subdomain.

Intelli
Were Samson Bruno

#### What's great

It has a beautiful UI and it just feels intuitive to use

#### What needs improvement [...] #### What needs improvement

Having an agentic documentation pipeline that doesn't wait for a button to be clicked to be able to generate the docs; something like CI/CD; immediately a PR is merged into the main branch an audit is performed then right when the audit results are in the docs are updated on a rolling basis with backward compatibility and user is notified via slack or chosen communication channel to approve the generation.

#### vs Alternatives

Docusaurus
Mintlify
Fumadocs

Ferndesk automates the process of generating the docs; it also has a feature to audit the current docs against the product changes to see gaps to fill in.
